paragraphs.text: 1. MAKE me a bull among my peers, make me my rivals, conqueror:
Make me the slayer of my foes, a sovran ruler, lord of kine
paragraphs.original: हन्तारं शत्रूणां कृधि विराजं गोपतिं गवाम्
paragraphs.translit: hantāraṃ śatrūṇāṃ kṛdhi virājaṃ gopatiṃ gavām

paragraphs.text: 2. I am my rivals' slayer, like Indra unwounded and unhurt,
And all these enemies of mine are vanquished and beneath my feet.
paragraphs.original: अधः सपत्ना मे पदोरिमे सर्वे अभिष्ठिताः
paragraphs.translit: adhaḥ sapatnā me padorime sarve abhiṣṭhitāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Here, verily, I bind you fast, as the two bow-ends with the string.
paragraphs.original: अत्रैव वोऽपि नह्याम्युभे आर्त्नी इव ज्यया ।
paragraphs.translit: atraiva vo'pi nahyāmyubhe ārtnī iva jyayā |

paragraphs.text: Press down these men, O Lord of Speech, that they may humbly speak to me.
4. Hither I came as conqueror with mighty all-effecting power,
And I have mastered all your thought, your synod, and your holy work.
paragraphs.original: आ वश्चित्तमा वो व्रतमा वोऽहं समितिं ददे
paragraphs.translit: ā vaścittamā vo vratamā vo'haṃ samitiṃ dade

paragraphs.text: 5. May I be highest, having gained your strength in war, your skill in peace
paragraphs.original: योगक्षेमं व आदायाहं भूयासमुत्तम आ वो मूर्धानमक्रमीम् । अधस्पदान्म उद्वदत मण्डूका इवोदकान्मण्डूका उदकादिव
paragraphs.translit: yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttama ā vo mūrdhānamakramīm | adhaspadānma udvadata maṇḍūkā ivodakānmaṇḍūkā udakādiva

paragraphs.text: my feet have trodden on your heads.
Speak to me from beneath my feet, as frogs from out the water croak, as frogs from out the water croak.
